newsitem.title: THAILAND: Four Thai schoolgirls drown in lake resort.
newsitem.headline: Four Thai schoolgirls drown in lake resort.

text.p: Four, 13-year-old Thai schoolgirls drowned in the popular northern resort town of Bungchanok after accidently falling into a lake, police said on Sunday.
They were among dozens of schoolgirls who were celebrating a friend's birthday at a resort about 500 kms (300 miles) north of Bangkok late on Saturday, police told Reuters.
After the party, one of the schoolgirls went to wash her hands at the mouth of the lake, but accidently slipped and fell in.
Three friends who rushed to help her also drowned, police quoted witnesses as saying.
